Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the use of certain marine facilities constructed by the department of transportation and funded in the omnibus transportation budget act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restricting the use of certain marine facilitiesconstructed by the department of transportation and funded in theomnibus transportation budget act; and adding a new section to chapter47.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any facility constructed by the department for the purpose ofbuilding pontoons or supporting equipment for bridges shall not be usedfor vessel construction, overhaul, conversion, or repair. However, thedepartment may lease the facility, or a portion of the facility, toother parties, either public or private, for vessel construction,overhaul, conversion, or repair, only if a full and fair market rate ischarged for the use of the facility. (2) For the purposes of this section, full and fair market rateshall be determined by a survey of rates and charges at marineconstruction and repair facilities in Washington state. (3) The department may not dispose, sell, or trade the facility p. 1 SB 6050except under the conditions of RCW 47.12.063, including the requirementof fair market value. (4) Any revenues derived from the use of the facility shall bedeposited into the motor vehicle account.
